source: tools/landmarks/towerbridge/build_towerbridge.py (procedural, real metres scaled by K = 0.40, vertex-colour PBR)
note: Three.js GLTFLoader asset; one mesh per LOD with one primitive per material (vertex-colour PBR atlas, night lights, two floodlit stone bands). No textures. Whole bridge: round-turreted towers with mullioned window groups, slate roofs and gilt cresting, walkways with a mid-span crest, Union Jack and St George flags, side spans with suspension chains and shore abutments. Loaded by js/world/towerbridge-asset.js; ?landmarks=procedural forces the procedural fallback. Carriageway portals remain open through stone barrel vaults in both LODs, including the shore towers; no blind dark backing planes. Face orientation uses direction vectors without the deck translation; all six unit-box directions are validated before export.
